PRT_rig_guard.orient: outer (motor-side) wall face on the bed, as the A3 body; every feature is an extrusion along print Z

PRT_rig_cover.orient: inner face on the bed; hinge boss up

PRT_rig_frame.orient: rear (encoder) face on the bed; cup ring, ribs, standoffs and foot flange grow up

PRT_flywheel.orient: motor-side web face on the bed; rim and hub grow up (top flange has a 45 deg underside)
PRT_flywheel.notes: A3 part, unchanged; 12-15 mm hockey tape on the 12.8 mm land

PRT_backplate.orient: on its side face (profile extruded, all walls vertical; stud pocket has a vertex up)
PRT_backplate.notes: A3 hood; stud pocket opened to the +X edge

PRT_nip_wheel.orient: outer face on the bed, nut trap up (press the nut in, dab of superglue)

BUY_motor_shaft.src: drawing: Ø5 x 21, 14 mm D-flat; rear stub

BUY_magnet.src: Ø6 x 2.5 diametric, glued to the rear shaft end

BUY_tape.src: 1/2 in hockey tape, 0.5 mm, one wrap on the 12.8 mm land
